overview_description.description: Sequence develops AI-powered revenue operations software that unifies configure, price, quote (CPQ), contract intake, billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, collections, and revenue recognition within a single platform. The software automates quote-to-cash workflows, manages customer contracts and subscription lifecycles, generates invoices, tracks payments, and supports financial reconciliation. The comapny integrates with CRM, ERP, accounting, payment, and business systems to synchronize commercial and financial data while providing reporting, workflow automation, approval processes, audit trails, and operational controls for finance and revenue teams.

about_short_description.short_description: Sequence provides AI-powered revenue operations software for CPQ, billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, and revenue recognition.

product.name: Sequence Billing Engine
product.description: A platform that automates billing for custom B2B contracts including usage-based, seat-based, and hybrid pricing models.

product.name: Sequence CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote)
product.description: A quoting and order form builder that creates custom sales quotes with complex pricing, integrated with CRM systems like Salesforce.

product.name: Sequence Revenue Recognition
product.description: A module that automates revenue recognition compliant with ASC 606 and IFRS 15 standards for accurate financial reporting.

product.name: Sequence Usage Metering API
product.description: An API that collects and processes customer usage data to support accurate billing and pricing models.

product.name: Sequence Customer Portal
product.description: A web portal that allows customers to view invoices, usage data, and manage payments securely.

product.name: Sequence Integrations
product.description: Connectors and sync tools that link Sequence with CRM, ERP, accounting, and payment platforms such as Salesforce, Xero, QuickBooks, Netsuite, Stripe, and Avalara.
